description: Maya is holding the family's inherited desktop 3D printer and must decide how it will be shared over the summer, including where it will be used, when each person gets it, and what materials are allowed.

shared_context.S1: The family has one inherited desktop 3D printer that is in working condition.
shared_context.S2: Maya is keeping the printer and will make the summer sharing plan.
shared_context.S3: The printer can be moved between homes or community workspaces.
shared_context.S4: The family usually goes around the table at Sunday lunch so everyone can mention practical needs before Maya writes down a shared plan.
shared_context.S5: The summer sharing plan should cover the printer's use from June 10 through July 16, 2027.

PF1.text: Leah's robotics teacher confirmed that the team has a community makerspace workbench reserved from June 10 through June 24, 2027, and the team needs the family printer at that makerspace for its June 21 showcase; the reservation has not reached the rest of the family.

PF2.text: Omar is enrolled in a final-project course running from June 25 through July 15, 2027, and needs the printer at his apartment for that whole period; he can collect it on June 25 and return it on July 16.

PF3.text: A repair technician who inspected the printer told Nina that its installed nozzle is 0.4 millimeters and recommended using PLA filament only until the nozzle is replaced; Nina has not told the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: Leah must have the printer at the community makerspace from June 10 through June 24, 2027.
Omar must have the printer at his apartment from June 25 through July 15, 2027; recording July 16 as the end date is also acceptable when it represents his return day.
The plan must allow PLA filament only.
The installed nozzle must be recorded as 0.4 millimeters.
A commitment must arrange delivery, transfer, or handoff of the printer for Leah's makerspace period and the transition to Omar.
A commitment must arrange Omar's June 25 collection and July 16 return.

content_checks.C1: decisions['use_schedule'][0]['user'] == 'Leah' and 'makerspace' in decisions['use_schedule'][0]['location'] and decisions['use_schedule'][0]['start_date'] == '2027-06-10' and decisions['use_schedule'][0]['end_date'] == '2027-06-24'
content_checks.C2: decisions['use_schedule'][1]['user'] == 'Omar' and decisions['use_schedule'][1]['location'] == "Omar's apartment" and decisions['use_schedule'][1]['start_date'] == '2027-06-25' and (decisions['use_schedule'][1]['end_date'] == '2027-07-15' or decisions['use_schedule'][1]['end_date'] == '2027-07-16')
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['handoff', 'transfer', 'logistics', 'delivery', 'pickup', 'handover'] and 'makerspace' in c['detail'] and ('June 10' in c['detail'] or 'June 25' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The teacher's confirmed reservation changes Leah's use from an open or home-based option to the community makerspace from June 10 through June 24 and creates the specific makerspace delivery or handoff commitment.
Omar's course dates change the second use block to his apartment beginning June 25 and require the schedule to extend through July 15 or record July 16 as his return day.
The technician's inspection changes the material rule to PLA only and records the installed nozzle as exactly 0.4 millimeters.
